ops.text: The temporary workstation is expected to support transfer equipment through power, workspace, connectivity and monitoring placement. Mounting the monitoring equipment on the stand remains optional, subject to suitable mounts, stability and conditions; ground-level tables are an alternative. ops.text: Equipment mounting remains an unresolved technical option. The prior transfer used separate tables. Standard clips may be insufficient; appropriate mounts and stability in wind or vibration conditions are concerns. Lowering the stand or retaining ground-level placement were discussed as contingencies. No mounting configuration was selected.

We can support it on the stand if we have the correct mounts. The concern is stability.

newVsExisting.whyNew: AI-204 coordinates access and staging, while NEW-1 separately verifies a specific route's suitability and establishes which route to use.
Arranging a staging location does not necessarily establish that its surface can support the equipment load or verify a safe alternative.
Distributing the previous discussion information and site slides is a separately deliverable communication, not completion of site coordination.
Providing the current meeting transcript is an independently completable document-delivery commitment.
Providing the previous day's partner-session summaries is a separate deliverable from both the current transcript and site coordination.
Forwarding and updating the recurring invitation is an independently completable administrative deliverable not covered by site-access coordination.
Confirming receipt of a meeting invitation is a distinct recipient-side result, unrelated to delivering the partner-site access contact.
